tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Leafsight's plant problem guides: common symptoms, pests, diseases and care mistakes of houseplants and garden plants (for example yellow leaves, leaf spot, aphids, overwatering, root rot, powdery mildew). Use for general questions about a plant symptom. Returns titles, summaries and askleafs

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read one Leafsight plant problem guide in full: what it looks like, common causes, what to do first, when to look closer, and its sources. Use a slug from search_guides. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: list_my_plants
tools.description: List the plants saved in the user's Leafsight account, each with its latest assessment and next check-in date, plus recent results not filed under a plant. Requires the user's Leafsight sign-in.

tools.name: get_plant
tools.description: One saved plant: its details and notes, its recent assessments with care steps (as available in the user's app), its next check-in and active care tasks. Use a plant_id from list_my_plants. Requires the user's Leafsight sign-in.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: One past assessment from the user's account: the likely problem, severity, symptoms, causes and care steps (as available in the user's app). Use a result_id from list_my_plants or get_plant. Requires the user's Leafsight sign-in.

tools.name: get_upcoming_checkins
tools.description: The user's scheduled plant check-ins, soonest first, marked overdue, due today or upcoming. Set include_other_care to also list watering and treatment tasks. Requires the user's Leafsight sign-in.
